exact_before.statement: In the pivotal setting of [[def-negligible-morphism-in-a-pivotal-category]], the negligible morphisms are closed under addition, scalar multiplication, arbitrary composition on either side, and tensor product on either side. Thus they form a two-sided tensor ideal. The proof uses an explicit partial-trace identity and does not assume that an arbitrary intertwiner of a tensor product factors as a tensor product of intertwiners.
